notes: Driving Mode: add a large high-contrast in-car view with D1-D9 preview, current/next destination, one-tap Google Maps driving directions, previous/next stop controls, schedule countdown, upcoming parking point, hotel/end point, hard-cut reminder, compact winter-driving weather warning, Live Cam and 5-day forecast shortcuts, plus optional screen wake lock where supported.
